title: LoRaWAN WoT Binding Schema Bundle
description: Bundle of validation rules for LoRaWAN Thing-level terms and LoRaWAN event-form terms. The Thing Description core model is validated elsewhere; this file documents and validates the binding-specific additions.

lorav:region.description: Regulatory region / profile of the device, e.g. 'EU868', 'US915'.

lorav:frequencyPlan.description: LoRaWAN Network Server frequency plan identifier, e.g. 'EU_863_870_TTN'.

lorav:payloadLayout.description: Overall structure of the device payload.

lorav:tagFields.description: For 'tlv'/'ctv' layouts, the leading tag field(s) (e.g. channel + type) that select a value.

not.description: Root keys that must never appear: the OTAA root keys are secrets and belong in security schemes, 'lorav:endian' is per-value and belongs on a form, and 'properties' is the withdrawn pre-events shape.

op.description: Uplinks are pushed by the device on its own schedule and cannot be polled, so a LoRaWAN form only ever offers event subscription operations.

lorav:wireType.description: Data type of the value on the wire, as an xsd:* alias or a native type. The value 'number' marks a derived value, which occupies no payload bytes.

lorav:endian.description: Byte order of this multi-byte value. Byte order only; there is no byte- or word-swap mode.

lorav:multiplier.description: Factor multiplied with the raw value. Prefer lorav:divisor for decimal scaling.

lorav:divisor.description: Factor the raw value is divided by. Preferred over lorav:multiplier for decimal scaling.

lorav:addend.description: Constant added to the value after scaling.

lorav:bitmask.description: Hexadecimal mask selecting a contiguous range of bits.

lorav:valueMap.description: Maps each integer on the wire to the value it denotes.

wireValue.description: The integer as it appears in the payload.

value.description: The decoded value. Any JSON type the event's data schema accepts.

lorav:byteOffset.description: Zero-based byte position of the value within a fixed payload layout.

lorav:byteLength.description: Byte length for variable-length wire types (string/bytes/hex/base64); -1 means consume the remaining bytes.

lorav:tag.description: Tag value(s), e.g. [channel, type], selecting this value in a tlv/ctv layout.

lorav:slot.description: 0-based order of this event within its group.

lorav:padBefore.description: Reserved bytes consumed immediately before this value within its group.

lorav:presentWhen.description: Condition gating whether this value appears in the payload.

field.description: Name of the value that decides the condition.

bit.description: Bit index in the flags field that must be set for this value to appear.

value.description: Discriminator value selecting the match case this value belongs to.

not.description: A value is gated either by a flag bit or by a discriminator value, never by both.

lorav:alias.description: Name under which other blocks reference this value as $alias.

lorav:derived.description: Describes a value computed from other decoded values rather than read off the wire.

ref.description: Input value, a $name reference to another event.

polynomial.description: Coefficients [c0, c1, ...] evaluated as c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ... over the input value.

compute.description: Binary operation {op, a, b} over two values or constants.

not.description: Scaling is stated once, as either a multiplier or a divisor.

then.description: A value computed from other values reads no payload bytes, so its wire type is 'number'.

descriptionNotes.thingLevel: Validate Thing-level lorav terms directly on the TD root object.
descriptionNotes.formLevel: Validate each LoRaWAN event form with #/$defs/lorawanForm.
